group.name: filemanager
group.title: File Manager Settings
group.description: Control the built-in File Manager admin module.

settings.name: filemanager_enabled
settings.title: Enable File Manager
settings.description: Set to 1 to allow administrators to use the File Manager. When set to 0 the File Manager module is hidden from the Admin CP.

settings.name: filemanager_max_upload
settings.title: Maximum upload size (MB)
settings.description: Maximum size, in megabytes, allowed for a single file uploaded through the File Manager. PHP's own upload_max_filesize still applies.

settings.name: filemanager_allowed_ext
settings.title: Allowed upload extensions
settings.description: Comma separated list of extensions that may be uploaded. Empty = allow any extension that is not in the blocked list.

settings.name: filemanager_blocked_ext
settings.title: Blocked upload extensions
settings.description: Comma separated list of extensions that can never be uploaded (dangerous executable types).
